purpose: Teach: 口語/前衛/性欲/優勢/伯爵/健常/皇位/綱領

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の口語表現を医療チームで丁寧に聞きます
lines.en: Ren, we listen carefully to our patients' own words here as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, steady opening. Professional but not distant. Direct eye contact. Measured pace that gives weight to each responsibility mentioned.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療現場の前衛的治療法を医療チームで検証します
lines.en: Yes — and we validate cutting-edge treatment approaches together as a team.
lines.style: Slight nod. Calm affirmation. Warm without softening the clinical precision. The tone of someone who has explained this many times and still means it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、性欲減退の相談も医療チームで受けます
lines.en: Ren, we also handle consultations about sexual health concerns—all of it, as a team.
lines.style: No hesitation. Direct, matter-of-fact delivery. Removes shame from the topic through her tone alone. Clinical warmth. Slight pause before 'as a team' for emphasis.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 診療科の優勢を、貴院、意識されてますね、先生
lines.en: You really do prioritize which departments lead, don't you? I can tell.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Respectful but genuinely curious—not flattering. Slight lean forward. Testing whether she'll confirm what he's noticed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、伯爵家ゆかりの病院記録を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Yes — we keep the hospital's historical records with care, including those connected to significant families.
lines.style: Measured continuation. Professional distance but not coldness. She's being transparent without overexplaining. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 健常児童の発達相談も、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: You also handle developmental consultations for healthy children here, don't you?
lines.style: Soft curiosity. Not asking for confirmation so much as understanding the full scope. Respectful. The tone of someone building a picture of the institution.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、皇位継承式での医療待機を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we're thorough about medical ethics and protocol compliance across everything we do.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. Pride without defensiveness. She's stating fact. Slight emphasis on 'thorough' — this is non-negotiable for her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療倫理綱領の遵守を、貴院、徹底されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does commit to ethical standards in every situation, doesn't it?
lines.style: Gentle pull-back. Still observant but warmer now. He's understood something important about her. Almost admiring. The tone softens slightly—genuine respect.
